title: windows-native-addon-manifest/v1
description: Frozen core ABI v1 provenance manifest for the package-relative win32-x64 N-API addon binary under native/windows/win32-x64/. Exact key set; additionalProperties false; raw bytes are LF-only and pinned by extensions/_shared/windows-native-addon-pin.ts (package output; not source closure). Core ABI is frozen at 1; versioned capabilities extend function surface without ABI bump. Capabilities is an extensible sorted-unique array that must contain retained_directory_lock_v1 (contains). Known allowlist currently includes atomic_file_tempdir_v1, atomic_file_v1, protected_dacl_v1, retained_directory_lock_v1; runtime manifest capabilities must exact-match native self-report. Unadvertised capabilities must not be called. Production zero-arg loader rejects missing pin, missing binary, invalid manifest, matrix mismatch, path symlink/reparse, capability mismatch, hash/size mismatch, source-commit pin mismatch, and post-load package_rx ACL failure (WINDOWS_NATIVE_ADDON_PACKAGE_ACL_INVALID) fail-closed. Evidence fields build_mode/reproducibility/native_tests/clippy/build_config_sha256 must exact-match binary BuildIdentity; package only accepts production+dual_clean_match+passed+passed. toolchain_id is sha256 of path/locale-free captured components (numeric cl/link versions; no cargo_home/rustup_home/raw banners). Package via scripts/package-windows-native-addon.mjs; no runtime download or auto-compile.

addon_abi.description: Frozen core ABI v1. Function surface expands only via versioned capabilities.

minimum_node.description: Frozen first-matrix Node floor. Exact string equality; prerelease suffixes are rejected. Runtime must be >= this value with prerelease-aware comparison.

source_commit.description: Full lowercase git commit SHA that produced the binary.

source_tree_sha256.description: sha256 of the native source closure bound into the binary build.

toolchain_id.description: sha256 of path/locale-free captured toolchain components (rustc -Vv, cargo -V, numeric cl/link versions, VCToolsVersion, trimmed WindowsSDKVersion, target, cargo config). Does not include cargo_home/rustup_home or raw locale banners.

target.description: Frozen ABI target triple fragment for the first support matrix.

binary_file.description: Fixed basename under native/windows/win32-x64/; no path separators.

binary_bytes.description: Exact on-disk byte length of the binary.

binary_sha256.description: Lowercase sha256 of the binary file bytes.

build_id.description: Deterministic build identity (sha256 of build_id preimage including source/toolchain/evidence fields); self-reported by the loaded addon.

build_mode.description: Build driver mode baked into binary BuildIdentity. Package accepts only production.

reproducibility.description: Dual clean rebuild evidence. Package accepts only dual_clean_match.

native_tests.description: Native cargo test gate result baked into identity. Package accepts only passed.

clippy.description: Native cargo clippy -D warnings gate result baked into identity. Package accepts only passed.

build_config_sha256.description: Lowercase sha256 of cargo config raw bytes (at least native/windows/.cargo/config.toml) bound into identity.

capabilities.description: Sorted unique versioned capability identifiers. Must contain retained_directory_lock_v1. Known allowlist is loader-side (atomic_file_tempdir_v1, atomic_file_v1, protected_dacl_v1, retained_directory_lock_v1); unadvertised capabilities must not be called. Runtime manifest must exact-match native getCapabilities().
